51534702.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to SRPK1 (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant by ITC assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: SRPK1 protein at 9 mg/mL was mixed with MSC-1186 to a final concentration of 1 mM. Crystals were directly obtained from the BCS coarse screen after mixing this solution in equal parts with 0.1 M cacodylate (pH 5), 15% PEG Smear Broad, 5% tacsimate, and 10% ethylene glycol at 4 °C. Crystals were cryoprotected in their mother liquor supplemented by 20% ethylene glycol and snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen.
original_paragraph.ITC Measurements: The ITC experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern, PA, USA) according to their standard protocols. Effects of test compounds on kinase activity were determined as percent inhibition at a single test concentration of 1 μM or as IC50 values calculated on a 10-dose 3-fold serial dilution in duplicate. The measurement data were processed by means of GraphPad Prism software. IC50 determinations were carried out by fitting a response curve to the data points by means of nonlinear regression analysis.
original_paragraph.Figure 9 caption: On-target cellular activity of MSC-1186 in HEK293T cells and cellular kinase selectivity (occupancy at 5 μM, cellular NanoBRET). The on-targets SRPK1/2/3 were not available on this screen. P38α and p38β were detected as minor off-targets with 36.1 and 11.3%, respectively. Circle sizes correspond to the data obtained as % inhibition, and benchmark circle sizes are given in the figure legend.
